issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' is explicitly forbidden by code style rule 5 (禁止残留模板占位符). The url field should be filled with the Conan recipe repository URL by the adapter, not left empty for CI to fill.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace 'url = ""  # CI fills this' with the actual recipe repository URL, e.g. url = "https://cnb.cool/ohos-rpms/archives/f/fastjar".

issues.description: notes.md pre-declares 'W4 Pre-PR 审计: PASS (P0=0, P1=0)' before the audit has been performed. This is a premature self-declaration of the audit result within the PR itself.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove or defer the W4 audit result line in notes.md until after the actual audit is completed. The line should be updated with the real audit result.

issues.description: Patch descriptions do not include the sequence number prefix as suggested by code style rule 12 (format: '0001 xxx'). Current descriptions are full sentences without the leading patch number (e.g., 'Update config.guess...' instead of '0001 Update config.guess...').
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider prefixing patch_description values with the sequence number for consistency, e.g., '0001 Update config.guess to support OHOS platform recognition'.
